question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128904/assets/9d755ff833ca8a9134d8f2548b6e7e26221a4814cda8a28093a345a2d321920e.svg)

find the cumulative distribution function $F(x).$
question.worked_solution:
Since our random variable $X$ has a probability distribution function $f(x)$ that is strictly positive only for $0 \leq x \leq 12,$ the cumulative distribution function takes the following form:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128904/assets/fd6306e35f5c55b4de635fe7d8967e7783f11c96cee2ea8adfdd17348f97a095.svg)

For the given probability density function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{0}^{x}\frac{1}{72}t\,\text{d}t \\ \text{ } & ={\frac{1}{144}{t}^{2}|}_{0}^{x} \\  & =\frac{1}{144}{x}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the cumulative distribution function is given by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128904/assets/b168cb9b6e4619e7b25cddea9ee671e665d057923b9562ff50d99ce874ea8b90.svg)
